name: Approved 20-second calibration
privacy: The video is private and never enters this repository; only these measurements do.
provenance: Measured frame by frame on the encoded export and recorded in skill/references/brandon-style-profile.md (Approved calibration grammar). To refresh the render metrics from the file, run: python3 production/editor/review_reel.py --measure /path/to/Brandon-Reel-Engine-20s-review.mp4 --out production/editor/reference/calibration-20s.render.json

compared.first_change: Something designed moves before the first second; the calibration's first scene change lands at 0.95 s with hero words rising before it.
compared.transition_rate: About three purposeful section changes in 17 s.
compared.caption_scale: Low captions at least the calibration's 34 px on a 720 frame (51 px on the 1080 grid). The house size is larger (66 px).
compared.title_scale: Designed titles at least the calibration's 62 px on a 720 frame (93 px on the 1080 grid).
compared.graphic_density: A designed graphic or state change every few seconds, word-cued, never a static slide.

not_compared.presenter_share: The calibration spends most of its length in full-screen grid panels. Brandon later asked to stay on camera behind most graphics, so presenter presence follows style_spec.json layout limits instead.
not_compared.green_wipe_and_row_bars: Retired after his review (green half-frame flash, timer-bar look).
not_compared.karaoke_captions: Retired on September 28: captions stay white with selective green, no per-word color change.

keep: Hero words rise beside Brandon in large white/green type while the short caption stays low
Small uppercase green kicker, large white title, spacious rows with green winning states
Counts start from zero on the spoken number; weak outcomes dim to about 30% or take a restrained red strike
A comparison value stays hidden until its spoken cue
Original voice carries the scene; selected quiet effects mark state changes; no music
